newsitem.title: FRANCE: CNCA says Suez stake enough.
newsitem.headline: CNCA says Suez stake enough.

text.p: French bank Credit Agricole said on Thursday it had achieved its objective with a seven percent stake and eight percent of the voting rights in Suez.
"Our objective has been reached," said Lucien Douroux, chief executive of Caisse Nationale du Credit Agricole when questioned by reporters on his bank's intentions towards the French holding company.
"What we want is a stable shareholder structure in Suez," Douroux, whose bank took control of Banque Indosuez in a deal struck with Suez earlier this year, told a news conference.
